item.title: Hurtado BBQ offers low-and-slow barbecue with Tex-Mex flavors
item.description: Chef and pitmaster Brandon Hurtado combines Texas barbecue with Mexican American traditions at Hurtado BBQ.

item.title: Trump to meet Venezuela's interim president and other leaders at UNGA
item.description: Trump and interim President Delcy Rodriguez will meet for the first time since the U.S. operation in Venezuela that captured Nicolas Maduro.

item.title: One killed as two glider planes collide in upstate New York, police say
item.description: New York State Police said at least one person was killed when two gliders collided in mid-air in upstate New York on Friday afternoon.

item.title: Iran live updates: Houthis claim attacks on Saudi facilities
item.description: A Houthi military spokesperson said Saturday that the group attacked sites in Saudi Arabia with ballistic missiles and drones.
